# Devil's Roulette Renewal 
Where devils congregate, and where guns, luck, mind games, and chaos reign supreme, hell's most wanted social club, "Devil's Roulette," has been reborn.

Pull up a chair — if you've got the nerve.
[media]
# 🎲Test Your Luck, Risk It All 🎲
Devil's Roulette -The Pit- is a thrilling VR party game for 1 to 4 players, featuring a variety of high-stakes game modes including Russian Roulette, Spin the Bottle, card-based bluffing, and more. Ready to go feral?
[media]

# 🎁 Freely Customize Skins and Trinkets🎁
Customize to your heart's content, from luxurious skins to an arsenal of guns and trinkets!
[media]

# 🧱A Multitude of Madness-Filled Stages🧱
Battle across numerous stunning stages with unique gimmicks, including some exclusive to specific game modes!
[media]

# 💬 Join the Discord!!
Check our Discord for the latest news, player interactions, free skin giveaways, and more!

https://mydearest.net/DevilsRoulette-BazookaDiscord
